# App test fixtures

`test_1022593.json.gz` is West Indies v India, Test, 21 July 2016 (India won by an innings after enforcing the follow-on), converted to CricScore's stored setup and event log from [Cricsheet](https://cricsheet.org) ball-by-ball data.
